commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_MAIN=7a21f68c4b0fe36e013081d43e4b667e3a4a77e8
git fetch origin main agent/gate-b-freeze-local-llm
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
git checkout -B agent/gate-b-freeze-local-llm origin/agent/gate-b-freeze-local-llm
test "$(git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_MAIN" HEAD; echo $?)" = "0"
echo "   " | base64 -d | python3
git diff --check
grep -F 'Status: `DONE / PROVEN_S22 / PHONE-LOCAL LLM PATH FROZEN`' docs/ROADMAP.md
grep -F 'Gate B is closed. Do **not** resume local-model hunting on the S22.' docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
git add docs/ROADMAP.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
git commit -m 'docs: freeze phone-local LLM path after Gate B'
git push origin HEAD:agent/gate-b-freeze-local-llm
COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git checkout -B main origin/main
git merge --ff-only "$COMMIT"
git push origin main
git push origin --delete agent/gate-b-freeze-local-llm
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo gate_b_freeze_commit=$COMMIT
echo gate_b_phone_local_llm_path_frozen=true
